Title: Additional IOPS feature for MySQL - Flexible Server in public preview

Body.Content:
Now in preview, MySQL - Flexible Server supports the provisioning of additional IOPS. This feature enables you to provision additional IOPS above the complimentary IOPS limit. Using this feature, you can also increase or decrease the number of IOPS based on your workload requirements at any time.

Learn More
